text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Wiesbaden stood at 14.0 €/m², up 5.3 % year‑on‑year and 24.1 % over the last five years, placing the city 10th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The rent premium over existing contracts is 52 %, while a 60 m² apartment costs about 840 € per month.

The market remains balanced with a 2.0 % vacancy rate, 27 days on market and 26 % of listings let within a week. Affordability is moderate: rent‑burden for two residents is 14.9 % and the median asking rent sits between the 12.2 €/m² (p25) and 16.17 €/m² (p75) range.

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 14.77 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging from 14.35 €/m² to 15.06 €/m², implying a further 5.5 % increase.
